fixed_alpha.identity: selected using training data ending 2025-12-31; not changed by this experiment

hypothesis: Positive volatility inflates ordinary shock thresholds during a strong advance. Use lagged downside-only root-mean-square returns of the unrestricted alpha book for rapid loss detection. Separately limit renewed exposure when the independently observable passive technology pool remains in a long downtrend. Both references continue while actual capital is cash.

rules.shock: alpha reference one-session loss exceeds max(2.5%, shock_z * prior-20-session downside RMS with 0.8% floor)
rules.slow_bear: passive reference NAV below its causal EMA(regime_span) and that EMA below its value ten sessions ago
rules.cap: cut immediately to zero on shock; otherwise reduce to bear_cap in slow_bear, one elsewhere
rules.recovery: recovery consecutive closes with passive NAV above EMA(10) and nonnegative passive daily return; no actual-NAV high-water reset or profit forgery
rules.positions: unchanged alpha membership; scale observed target proportions on cap transitions, otherwise retain economic units unless alpha has a genuine target change
rules.execution: unchanged next-open cash engine, capacity and fee assumptions

selection_rule: Prefer candidates whose training wealth is no lower, drawdown no higher, and filled-order count no higher than the incumbent in every scope. Among those maximize the existing mean log-relative-wealth minus drawdown/turnover objective. If none qualify, label NO_TRAINING_DOMINANCE and select the least worst normalized deficit only as a diagnostic; this is not a relaxed acceptance.
objective: mean(log(wealth / matched buy_hold wealth) - 0.75 * max_drawdown - 0.002 * max(0, orders_per_year - 20))
deficit: max over scopes and metrics of log(incumbent wealth / candidate wealth), log(candidate drawdown / incumbent drawdown), log((candidate filled orders+1)/(incumbent filled orders+1)), clipped below at zero
evidence: All historical evaluation remains retrospective. Preserve every candidate and failed predecessor. No dates, security identifiers or excluded names enter production signals. No default promotion without separately measured joint economics.
